about: Synthetic problem-framing cards for Week 08 Day 1. Decide for each card: classification, regression, unsupervised or not_ml.

demo.title: Supervisor review
demo.description: Predict whether a new lost-item request will need a supervisor review, learning from past requests that are marked reviewed or not reviewed.

demo.title: Document effort
demo.description: Estimate how many minutes a new document request will take to handle, learning from past requests with recorded minutes.

demo.title: Desk profiles
demo.description: Group desks by their mix of request types. Nobody has defined the groups in advance.

demo.title: Weekly count
demo.description: Count how many traffic requests arrived last week.

demo.title: Language flag
demo.description: Flag online requests written in a language other than Arabic or English, learning from requests that staff already labelled.

demo.title: Walk-in forecast
demo.description: Forecast next week's number of walk-in requests per desk from the weekly counts of previous weeks.

practice.title: Duplicate submissions
practice.description: Decide whether a new online request is a duplicate submission, learning from requests already marked duplicate or not duplicate.

practice.title: Waiting time
practice.description: Estimate the hours until the first action on a new request, learning from past requests with recorded waits.

practice.title: Text themes
practice.description: Find groups of similar requests from their free-text descriptions. There is no list of categories.

practice.title: March medians
practice.description: Report the median handling minutes per desk for March.

practice.title: Survey response
practice.description: Predict whether a requester will answer the optional satisfaction survey, learning from past requests where we know if they answered.

practice.title: Staffed hours
practice.description: Estimate the total staffed hours a desk will need next month, learning from the hours and request volumes of previous months.

practice.title: Unusual days
practice.description: Discover days whose request pattern looks unlike other days. Nobody has labelled any day as unusual.

practice.title: Request category
practice.description: Sort new requests into Report, Traffic, Document or Lost Item from the request text, learning from requests that were already categorised.

practice.title: Stale requests
practice.description: List every request that is still open seven days after it was opened.

practice.title: Visit patterns
practice.description: Segment walk-in visits into typical time-of-day patterns, without any labelled patterns.
